title: Add install and update CLI regression tests
description: Exercise installer/update argument parsing, architecture mapping, release verification, and failure handling in temporary fixtures without system changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover amd64/arm64 mapping and unsupported architecture rejection
Tests cover pinned version, mirror, install directory, data directory, and dry-run/fixture options
Tests prove no `npm ci`, `npm install`, or `next build` command runs in the release-install path
Tests cover missing checksum, malformed archive, failed readiness, and rollback without touching the host system

steps.description: Write a shell or Node harness that invokes installer/update with a temporary root and command stubs, expecting release-only behavior.
Add dry-run/test hooks or environment overrides without weakening production validation; keep root/service operations disabled in fixture mode.
Execute each negative case and assert nonzero exit, clear category, no active-release mutation, and sanitized output.
Execute a temporary successful install/update/rollback and assert version/pointer transitions.

technicalNotes: Use shellcheck if installed; otherwise use `bash -n` and the focused harness. Never run the real installer with sudo in tests.
